name: Создание паспорта проекта в Excel
description: Генерирует файл Excel с паспортом проекта: problem statement (SBC), цели SMART, команда, вехи. Данные берутся из БД проекта.
code:
function create_passport_excel(db_name, project_id):
    # Извлекает данные паспорта из БД
    project = db.query('SELECT * FROM project WHERE id = ?', [project_id])
    problems = db.query('SELECT * FROM problem_statement WHERE project_id = ?', [project_id])
    goals = db.query('SELECT * FROM goal_smart WHERE project_id = ?', [project_id])
    team = db.query('SELECT * FROM team_member WHERE project_id = ?', [project_id])
    # Формирует Excel с 4 листами: Project, Problems, Goals, Team
    return file_creator.createExcelFromDb(db_name, 'passport', {
        'Project': project,
        'Problem Statement': problems,
        'Goals SMART': goals,
        'Team': team
    })
